correctness.rationale: For each fixed n≥2 the joint count w_n(k,f)=binom(n,f)d(n−f,k−f), with d(r,a) derangement-cycle count. Re-derived recurrence d(r,a)=(r−1)(d(r−1,a)+d(r−2,a−1)); Q_m recurrence corresponds to characteristic polynomial of a symmetric Jacobi matrix, proving real negative roots and strict Newton coefficient log-concavity. The coupled determinant arrays A,B obey A_(r,a)=(r−1)B_(r−1,a−1), B_(r,a)=(r−1)(L_(r−1,a)+A_(r−1,a)), so adjacent minors are nonnegative and strict within common support. Positive crossed entries force a complete positive rectangular support, allowing multiplication of adjacent inequalities to prove all TP2 minors. Ewens θ>0 multiplies each k-row by θ^k, preserving strict signs and F|K distribution; at k=1,n extremes F takes 0,n, so strictly monotone transforms have positive covariance. Independently generated actual permutations through n=7 and tested exact minors through n=18; finite tests corroborate the recurrence, not infinite positivity.
